text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Right now, I am offering detailed explanations
of the "Mecha Umamusume" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
<username>, 
do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, what would you like me to explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When it comes to what I wanted to ask about training "Mecha Umamusume"—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About the "UGE," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The UGE—short for "Upgrade Exam"—
is a test designed to assess the research progress
of the Mecha Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The UGE takes place 5 times in total,
and the sum of your Research Levels within
each period will serve as your evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"To earn high praise,
maintaining balance in your training is crucial!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, while participating in the Twinkle Series, everyone will also be participating in the UGE.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that depending on training conditions,
your training may conclude even while the
UGE is still in progress!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation of the "UGE."
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About "Research Lv," correct?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There are 5 types of Research Lv: "Speed,"
"Stamina," "Power," "Guts,"
and "Wisdom."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Research Lv increases through various trainings.
Check to see which training increases
which Research Lv!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Research Lv increases more the more
research members and Support Cards
train together with you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, as your Research Level goes up,
the training effectiveness for the Umamusume
will also increase!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There is a cap on the Research Lv for each training period.
Keep an eye on the balance as you work toward achieving your training goals.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
regarding "Research Lv."
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'd like to know about "Tuning," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
After the UGE is over,
you can perform tuning on the Mecha Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Mecha Umamusume have three types of cores: Head, Torso, and Legs, and each core has three chips.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Allocating Mecha Energy, or Mecha EN for short, to each of those chips is called Tuning.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The more Mecha EN you allocate,
the greater the training support effect provided by chips will be.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Also, you can reallocate your Mecha EN each time a UGE concludes!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The amount of Mecha EN you obtain varies depending on UGE, so please aim for a high evaluation so you can tune them exactly the way you want.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation about Tuning.
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: This is about "Overdrive," isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Overdrive is a special mode that,
once activated, yields even greater effects.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Overdrive gauge is filled via
training equipped with Mecha Gear.
Alternatively—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Increases through resting,
going out, racing, etc."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By maxing out the Overdrive gauge,
you'll be able to activate Overdrive!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The effects gained from activating Overdrive
are determined by each core's settings and total Mecha EN.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"You can also stock up on activations.
Up to 2 charges can be stored,
so saving them for key moments is recommended!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation
about 'Overdrive.'
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any time
by tapping the 'i' button in the top left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck.
I'll be cheering you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best,
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
